candidates.statement: I. Introduction This guidance provides information on the most frequently asked questions regarding the transfer or sale of a 510(k) clearance from one 510(k) holder to another. Under section 510(k) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act) and its implementing regulations, any person required to register under section 510 / 21 CFR 807.20 must generally submit a premarket notification submission, or “510(k),” if the device is being introduced into commercial distribution for the first time , or the device is one that the person currently has in commercial distribution or is reintroducing into commercial distribution , but that is about to be significantly change d or modif ied in design, components, method of manufacture, or intended use . 1 This guidance discusses when the sale or transfer of a 510(k) would not require the new holder of a 510(k) to submit a new 510(k) under applicable law , as well as circumstances under which entities m ust use the FDA - assigned premarket submission number of the cleared 510(k) when listing their device .
candidates.context: Transfer of a Premarket Notification (510(k)) Clearance – Questions and Answers Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff This guidance represents the current thinking of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) on this topic . It does not establish any rights for any person and is not binding on FDA or the public . You can use an alternative approach if it satisfies the requirements of the applicable statutes and regulations . To discuss an alternative approach, contact the FDA staff or Office responsible for this guidance as listed on the title page. In general, FDA’s guidance documents do not establish legally enforceable responsibilities.

An owner or operator of an establishment who is engaged in the manufacture, preparation, propagation, compounding, assembly, or processing of a device intended for human use is generally required to register the establishment and submit listing information for all devices in commercial distribution. 11

candidates.statement: 4. I obtained a 510(k) clearance from another company (via transfer, sale, etc.). Do I need to submit a new 510(k)? W hen a 510(k) clearance for a specific device is sold or transferred from one person to another and the device is not significantly changed or modified in design, components, method of manufacture, or intended use, 19 the new 510(k) holder does not need to submit a new 510(k), since the new 510(k) holder would not be proposing “to begin the introduction or delivery for introduction into interstate commerce for commercial distribution” of a device. 20 See question 10 for more details about the obligations of the 510(k) holder regarding a transfer or sale of a 510(k ).
candidates.context: modif ied in design, components, method of manufacture, or intended use . 18 See question s 1 and 6 for more information about registration. 5. What are the listing requirements for a new 510(k) holder? When a 510(k) clearance for a specific device is sold or transferred from one person to another, if the new 510(k) holder is engaged in any of the activities requiring listing, 21 CFR 807.25 requires the new 510(k) holder to list the device in FDA’s electronic device registration and listing system . 21 The system assigns a new unique listing number when the new 510(k) holder creates the listing. 22 For further information about registering and listing, see the webpage, “ How to Register and List .”

candidates.statement: 6. When should a new 510(k) holder register and list? T he new 510(k) holder must, if not previously entered into an operation described in 21 CFR 807.20(a), register within 30 days after entering into such an operation and submit device listing information, including the FDA - assigned 510(k) premarket notification submission number of the cleared device , 23 at that time. 24

candidates.statement: 9. Who can use a 510(k) holder’s 510(k) number to list a device? Anyone who is required to list a cleared device, including contract manufacturers, contract sterilizers, repackagers, and relabelers, is required to use the FDA - assigned premarket submission number of the cleared 510(k) to list the device. 38 The 510(k) holder is also responsible for complying with applicable requirements arising under the FD&C Act.

candidates.context: 11. Who must update information about a 510(k) transfer or sale ? FDA commonly receives notifications from individuals that a 510(k) clearance has been transferred to that individual from a previous 510(k) holder, and asking FDA to update the information in the registration and listing database s . However, it is the responsibility of the owner or operator of the establishment 44 to ensure that it is meeting the registration and listing requirements of the FD&C Act. FDA is not required to update registration or listing information in response to such notifications .
